failure_modes: Treating a game of information as a physical forecasting problem that more data would solve
Ignoring one's own effect on the environment being modelled
gloss: Intelligences modelling each other modelling them, where the missing information is a property of the system
invariants: Publishing a prediction can change the behaviour it predicts
The only prediction immune to reflexivity is a self-fulfilling one
Measuring an agent's state can alter it
mechanism: When autonomous agents model each other's perceptions and intentions, and model the others modelling them, the regress has no fixed point. Three dynamics mark the situation: it changes before it can be analysed in full, a special case of {{computational_irreducibility}}; crucial information cannot be obtained without disturbing the system; and predictions change the outcomes they predict. Here {{bounded_model_open_world}} is not a practical limit but structural. Each {{model_as_compression}} of another agent becomes an input that agent can react to.
